root_causes: Goal-condition mismatch: the planner considered only the spatial relation (toy_animal_2 next_to toy_vehicle_1 on table_16) and ignored that the user-specified target objects were toy_vehicle_0 and toy_animal_2, leading to using the wrong vehicle instance (toy_vehicle_1 instead of toy_vehicle_0).

Object identity confusion: the system did not enforce that the moved vehicle must be the designated task object toy_vehicle_0 from the chest_of_drawers_38 and instead treated any toy_vehicle on the table as interchangeable.

Incomplete task completion criteria: the internal task progress was marked 2/4 even after both toys were placed next to each other on the table, indicating that the planner’s proposition set did not fully capture all user goals (e.g., explicit move-from-chest conditions or correct object IDs), so the episode terminated without satisfying all logical conditions.
improvement_suggestions: Tighten object grounding so that task objects (toy_vehicle_0, toy_animal_2, toy_construction_set_3) are strictly bound to their unique IDs throughout planning and execution, and disallow substitution with similarly-typed objects (e.g., toy_vehicle_1).

Include explicit pre- and post-conditions for source locations (e.g., toy_vehicle_0 on chest_of_drawers_38 before, not on chest_of_drawers_38 after) in the goal specification so that moving the correct items from the chest is required for success.

Augment the planner’s goal-checking to require all user-stated constraints: specific objects, target receptacle (table_16), spatial relation (next_to), and preservation of non-target objects’ locations (toy_construction_set_3 remains where it is).

Improve debugging signals so that when episode_end occurs with partial completion (2/4 propositions), the system reports which logical goals remain unsatisfied (e.g., ‘correct vehicle not moved’), enabling targeted fixes.
Adjust the rearrange policies to prioritize manipulating the exact goal objects first, and only then refine spatial relations, rather than refining relations with an already-wrong object instance.
overall_assessment: The agents partially fulfilled the spatial arrangement on the table but failed to move the correct toy vehicle specified in the task, leading to only half of the logical goals being satisfied. Execution shows reasonable low-level control but weak grounding to the exact user-specified objects and conditions.
task_instruction: Help me tidy up the bedroom. Move the toy vehicle and toy animal from the chest of drawers to the table. Place them next to each other. Leave the toy construction set where it is.
